name: Habit Rings
shortDescription: Close your rings every day and watch a year of streaks fill in.
description: A habit tracker page for one person. Up to eight habits sit as concentric rings on one dial for today, and one tap closes a ring; a countable habit like eight glasses of water fills a step at a time. The streak of days with every ring closed is the headline, rolled up like an odometer. Under the dial, each habit has a 53-week year map that darkens as a run of days grows, with the date and what was done on any day under a tap or the pointer. On a phone it is one column you open every day, with a swipe across the dial to fix yesterday. On a desktop, Today sits beside the whole year, and keys 1 to 8 close the rings. Days stay in the browser, with Save a copy and Load a copy to move them. Themes: paper, ink, neon, or follow the device.
